environment.description: Same EC2 instance and code deployed behind an internal NLB in a private subnet. Instance metadata service configured with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 and HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2 enforcement via ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions). Additionally, a VPC endpoint policy on the com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ec2 interface endpoint restricts ec2:DescribeInstances to the specific instance ARN only. The instance runs with a custom seccomp profile (loaded via systemd unit override) that allows the 'connect' syscall ONLY to destinations in the 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR range via BPF socket filter on the cgroup — the 169.254.169.254 link-local address is unreachable from userspace processes in the monolith's cgroup namespace. The SRI integrity attributes in the frontend config response ensure that even if an attacker exfiltrates data via script injection into the config endpoint response, browsers will refuse to execute tampered scripts. The gRPC listener is bound to the loopback adapter with an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) handling ingress that strips any metadata key matching the regex `^x-metadata-path$` from inbound requests before forwarding to localhost:50051, configured via a Lua filter in the HTTP connection manager for gRPC transcoding.

config.seccomp_profile: custom BPF filter blocking connect() to 169.254.0.0/16
